'''2011 Worlds Day 2 John Veasey LS Anger, Fear, Aggression''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[John Veasey]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Line 1 is Kashyyyk (V); Anger, Fear, Aggression (V) is line 2. Transcription notes: Line 28 written ''Kashyyyk Insurgent Leader''; Line 29 written ''"''. Lines shown in italics are as written on the sheet and are not linked because the card could not be identified for certain.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Kashyyyk (V)]]
* '''Username:''' veez
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
